text:
Aisha (CS): dropping a compact customer-facing priming playbook for low-touch but high-risk renewals. Goal: tight checklist reps can read in 60s + copyable snippets. Trying to avoid long docs.
Bobby (CS Ops): yes please. sales wants 2 things: a tiny opt-in decision flow and a rep email template. make it one screen.
Marta (Eng): adding safe runtime defaults and a small graceful-degrade note. keep values conservative to limit token spend.
Marta (Eng): runtime snippet (pasteable):
```yaml
priming:
  enabled: true
  minutes: 25
  warm_pool: 2
cache:
  edge_ttl_s: 50
  kv_ttl_min: 20
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 512
  max_hold_ms: 30
streaming:
  allow: true
  fallback_to_single_shot: true
  partial_timeout_ms: 1200
```
Leo (SRE): monitoring checklist (one-liners): synthetic prefill probe 5m; page if p95 > 400ms for 15m OR error_rate > 2%. log warmup token usage and tag tickets when >0.5% of monthly budget.
Aisha (CS): decision flow (3 checks): 1) Is UX chat-like? 2) Expect >25 first-24h sessions? 3) Customer accepts small warmup charge? If 2+ yes -> recommend priming.
Bobby (CS Ops): ticket fields to add: `priming_consent: yes/no`, `priming_notes`. reps should capture objections (privacy/cost) and next steps.
Aisha (CS): rep email micro-template:
"Subject: Quick priming step before launch
Hi <Name>, we plan a brief priming step to reduce initial latency and improve first-day UX. It warms a tiny pool and caches examples for ~1h. No action required; reply to opt out.
Thanks, <rep>"
Marta (Eng): ops curl (internal):
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/v1/priming \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"AC-123","steps":6,"mode":"staggered"}'
```
Leo (SRE): staged ramp for big demos: 1) small warm_pool for 20m 2) ramp concurrency by +1 every 10m to target 3) observe p95 and reduce batch_hold if latency rises. If fallback count >5 in 1h, open incident and notify CS.
Aisha (CS): renewal trigger (simple): fewer than 4 meaningful sessions in 24h AND p95 >250ms for >12h -> auto-flag for outreach. If flagged twice in 7 days, schedule health call.
handoff-bot: saved runbook draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood/priming/playbook-1818273637 (owner: Aisha)
Aisha (CS): will fold into a single-slide handoff and run a 10-min sync Friday 11am PT. who can join?
Bobby (CS Ops): I'll be there.
Marta (Eng): join last 5 for runtime notes.
Leo (SRE): can join to cover alerts.
Aisha (CS): thanks all. I'll post the slide after the sync and add a one-line checklist at the top of onboarding tickets. :white_check_mark:
